jobs.title: Product Manager – CA
jobs.description: Description Business Transformation is a strategic group focused on evolving the way we support our sellers and coworkers on our process, policy and technology transformation efforts. This group partners with stakeholders across the enterprise to develop strategies, build plans, prioritize efforts, implement changes and measure outcomes. The Product Management Team falls under the Business Transformation group and focuses on defining the long-term product strategy for our digital seller team. The Product Manager – Hardware & Software role will be responsible for driving the strategic direction of our products, from conception to execution, working closely with cross-functional teams to define product vision, roadmap, and objectives, ensuring alignment with business goals and customer needs. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with excellent communication skills and a passion for delivering innovative solutions. A successful candidate will need to be comfortable synthesizing a clear, logical, data driven narrative out of confusing, ambiguous and at times conflicting information. Key Areas of Responsibility • Build strong relationships with both technical and non-technical teams such as Product Managers, Product Owners, Developers, Digital Engagement Managers, and Product Marketing. • Build strong relationships with product end users such as Sales, Integrated Tech Services (Now known as Solutions and Services or S&S), Operations, Product & Purchase Management (PPM), and Finance teams. • Comfortable speaking, presenting, and demoing capabilities at all levels of an organization up to C-suite • Define and track key performance indicators (KPI’s) to measure the success of product initiatives against business objectives • Comfortable with hypothesis-driven feature development • Develop and articulate a clear product roadmap that aligns with company objectives and market trends • Translate roadmap into actionable strategies to drive product growth and innovation • Define and maintain journey maps to understand user journeys by persona • Own and prioritize product backlog, ensuring alignment between stakeholders and technology • Conduct market research and user interviews to identify customer requirements and validate product hypotheses • Lead feature prioritization and coordination with agile teams to plan and execute Program Increments (PI’s) • Create and maintain Program Increment artifacts such as feature backlogs, WSJF’s, Sprint Plans, and Release Notes • Collaborate with architects, designers, and product owners to develop innovative and scalable solutions that meet customer needs and technical requirements The information in this position description is intended to convey information about the key responsibilities and requirements of the position. It is not an exhaustive list of the skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the opportunity. Position Descriptions are subject to change. jobs.description: Our Purpose Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. Title and Summary Manager, Product Management, Identity Solutions Overview: The Identity Solutions team leads the development and delivery of innovative products that help partners identify their customers and enable simple and secure digital experiences for consumers in payments and beyond. Our token intelligence team focuses on preventing fraudulent tokens from being created and protecting the emerging token ecosystem. As digital interactions and transactions become increasingly tokenized, the team develops risk intelligence and network signals that help customers establish trust at token creation and throughout the customer journey. By connecting fraud, identity, and token intelligence across the ecosystem, the team is defining how trust is established and maintained in the next generation of digital commerce. The company develops AI-powered consumer experiences that allow users to interact with AI characters through conversations, voice, image generation and video. This is a newly created, high-impact role focused on taking full product ownership of trust, safety and compliance capabilities across a large-scale consumer platform. You will be responsible for defining and delivering safety-related product features, including AI content moderation, age verification, detection systems and red-teaming initiatives. Working directly with engineers, you will translate complex safety and regulatory challenges into practical product solutions. You will collaborate closely with the CTO, Legal & Safety Lead and Product Lead, making important decisions that balance user protection, regulatory obligations and the overall product experience. This is a hands-on product management role, not a policy, legal or trust and safety operations position.
